title: AI Trading Platforms Compared
author: roe-IQ
selftext:
Choosing the right AI trading platform is no longer just about charting—it's about actionable insights, automation, and market intelligence.

We compared five popular platforms across key features including:

• AI Stock Picks  
• AI Option Analysis

• Smart Alerts  
• Strategy Backtesting

If you're evaluating AI tools for trading and investing, this comparison provides a quick overview to help you get started.
